reason: Owner request on November 19, 2026: ship the iOS crash fix for #1679 to internal TestFlight. Upload ONE fresh monotonic iOS 1.4 App Store-eligible TestFlight build from current reviewed protected main containing that fix. Preserve approved production iOS AdMob App ID, UMP/ATT, user consent, privacy manifest audits, membership/ad-free gating, Apple Elite billing, and existing TestFlight beta groups. Require production-eligible signed archive, Apple VALID processing, correct iOS 1.4 version attachment when editable, and IN_BETA_TESTING availability verified by Apple API. Internal TestFlight distribution only: do not submit App Review or publicly release. Do not modify Google Play tracks, app privacy declarations, testers, web/backend or Vercel.
